statement.p: Find the equation of the tangent plane to the surface determined by x^4 y^4 + z - 30 = 0 at x=2, y=5.

static.solution: z = f(x,y) = 30-x^{4}y^{4}, and f(2,5) = -9970. We have f_x(x,y) = -\left(4x^{3}y^{4}\right),\quad \hbox{ so}\quad f_x(2,5) = -20000, and f_y(x,y) = -\left(x^{4}\cdot 4y^{3}\right),\quad \hbox{ so}\quad f_y(2,5) = -8000. Thus, the tangent plane is z = f(2,5) + f_x(2,5)(x - 2) + f_y(2,5)(y - 5), or z = -9970 - 20000 (x - 2) - 8000 (y - 5) = -\left(9970+20000\mathopen{}\left(x-2\right)+8000\mathopen{}\left(y-5\right)\right).
